editorial_standard: Curated official tools only; no copied datasets, inferred contamination, personal information or legal conclusions.

groups.name: Global reference
groups.description: Comparative datasets, not personal or real-time measurements.

groups.name: United States
groups.description: Air conditions, reported releases, compliance and drinking-water reports.

groups.name: Europe
groups.description: Near-real-time air indicators and declared major industrial releases.

groups.name: Canada
groups.description: Air-health forecasts and a national industrial emissions inventory.

groups.name: United Kingdom
groups.description: Postcode-based air information and industrial emissions records.

portals.name: WHO ambient air quality database
portals.coverage: City and town measurements from 127 WHO members, associate members or territories; not every settlement.
portals.finds: Annual average PM2.5, PM10 and nitrogen dioxide concentrations for selected settlements.
portals.how: Find your city, confirm its reporting year and measurement coverage, and compare cautiously.
portals.limit: A historical city-wide annual mean is not today's local AQI or a personal exposure measurement.

portals.name: AirNow air-quality information
portals.coverage: U.S. location-level monitors and forecasts; availability varies by place and pollutant.
portals.vintage: Current/forecast AQI with real-time data caveats
portals.finds: AQI levels, smoke information and health-oriented air-quality categories.
portals.how: Enter a location and check monitor coverage, forecast time and any advisories.
portals.limit: A monitor or sensor does not identify all local exposures, individual doses or a responsible facility.

portals.name: EPA ECHO facility compliance
portals.coverage: Facilities recorded in applicable EPA and state/tribal environmental reporting systems.
portals.vintage: Mixed enforcement, permit and reporting windows
portals.finds: Facility permit details, inspection records, reported violations and enforcement actions.
portals.how: Search a location or facility ID; read the agency's data definitions and status dates.
portals.limit: A listed violation can be alleged rather than finally adjudicated; missing records do not prove a facility is safe.

portals.name: EPA Toxics Release Inventory
portals.coverage: Facilities and chemicals meeting TRI reporting rules, not every source of pollution.
portals.vintage: Annual self-reported releases; the EPA toolbox lists current tool status
portals.finds: Reported chemical releases, waste transfers and pollution-prevention information.
portals.how: Use EPA's TRI Toolbox to select a current search or download tool; confirm substance, year and reporting thresholds.
portals.limit: Pounds released are not a measured population dose or toxicity ranking, and some tools may be offline.

portals.name: Annual drinking-water quality reports
portals.authority: U.S. EPA and local public water systems
portals.coverage: Community public-water suppliers; not a private well or a household's individual tap.
portals.finds: Water sources, reported regulated contaminants, violations and supplier contacts.
portals.how: Find your supplier's Consumer Confidence Report, then ask about the location and timing of relevant sampling.
portals.limit: A supplier-wide report cannot substitute for a qualified lead or other contaminant test at one tap.

portals.name: European Air Quality Index
portals.coverage: European monitoring stations and modeled air-quality areas; data availability varies.
portals.vintage: Near-real-time station information and model forecasts
portals.finds: Short-term air quality estimates for PM2.5, PM10, NO2, ozone and SO2.
portals.how: Choose a place, distinguish actual stations from modeled areas, and check the timestamp.
portals.limit: The Index is not a legal compliance determination or a long-term annual air-quality assessment.

portals.name: European Industrial Emissions Portal
portals.coverage: Major industrial complexes under covered European reporting requirements, not all businesses.
portals.vintage: Annual facility and pollutant reports; check reporting year
portals.finds: Reported industrial releases to air, water and land, transfers of waste and facility details.
portals.how: Find a facility on the map, select a pollutant and reporting year, and read the methodology.
portals.limit: An annual reported mass does not show local exposure or prove legal responsibility.

portals.name: Canadian Air Quality Health Index
portals.coverage: Canadian AQHI reporting communities; station and location coverage varies.
portals.finds: A health-oriented indicator based on air pollutant measurements and forecast conditions.
portals.how: Select a community and review the advice for its risk category and the current timestamp.
portals.limit: A community AQHI is not an individual exposure estimate and local conditions can vary.

portals.name: National Pollutant Release Inventory
portals.coverage: Reporting facilities and substances under NPRI thresholds across Canada.
portals.vintage: 2025 records are labeled preliminary in the current search tool
portals.finds: Facility-reported air, water, and land releases, disposals and transfers.
portals.how: Filter by location, facility or substance and verify whether the year is reviewed or preliminary.
portals.limit: Preliminary data can contain reporting errors; facility releases are not individual dose measurements.

portals.name: Check air quality in the UK
portals.authority: UK Department for Environment, Food & Rural Affairs
portals.coverage: Area-level air forecasts and available monitors in the UK.
portals.vintage: Current monitoring and forecasts where provided
portals.finds: Air quality by locality or postcode, alerts and exposure guidance.
portals.how: Search a postcode or place and check the forecast, station data and health message.
portals.limit: A local forecast is an indicator, not a personal diagnosis or source-attribution model.

portals.name: Environment Agency Pollution Inventory
portals.authority: Environment Agency / UK National Data Library
portals.coverage: Regulated major industrial sites in England within the inventory's reporting scope.
portals.vintage: Downloadable annual data for 2013–2024 at the time of review
portals.finds: Reported annual releases to air and water and waste movements from qualifying sites.
portals.how: Download a reporting year and verify facility permit boundaries and substance units.
portals.limit: Large sites are covered selectively; reported annual masses do not describe personal exposure.

portals.name: Australian National Pollutant Inventory
portals.coverage: Australian facilities and diffuse sources within NPI reporting rules.
portals.finds: Annual releases and waste transfers of listed NPI pollutants, including facility mapping.
portals.how: Select the facilities map or database, then check substance, year and calculation method.
portals.limit: Different chemicals cannot be summed into a meaningful total-harm ranking; reported release is not confirmed exposure.
